project.name: Gemma-Cyber v0.2 (exp-002): Free Cloud QLoRA Training & GGUF Export
project.stated_purpose: Fine-tune Gemma-3-4B-it on a curated cybersecurity instruction dataset using QLoRA, merge the LoRA weights into the base model, and export a quantized GGUF model for local inference with Ollama.
project.prior_model_context: gemma3-cyber:v0.1 is described in the notebook as only a system-prompt alias of the base model (not an actual fine-tune). exp-002 is described as the project's first real fine-tune.
project.dataset_rationale: sft_v0.2 is described as the first dataset with genuine answer-level diversity (277/277 unique answers vs. v0.1's 91/360) across 15 task types, and explicitly teaches exact ATT&CK IDs (e.g. Kerberoasting = T1558.003, contrasted with a hallucinated T1060 attributed to v0.1/base behavior).
project.chat_format_note: Gemma templates historically reject a standalone system role and use role name 'model' (not 'assistant'). The notebook uses the repo's own to_gemma_chat_text() formatter instead of the tokenizer's chat template, and masks loss to only the model-turn tokens.
project.intended_downstream_use: Quantized GGUF model (gemma3-cyber-v0.2-Q4_K_M.gguf) run locally via Ollama, evaluated against base gemma3:4b on two benchmark sets (benchmark_v2.jsonl, benchmark_v3.jsonl).
project.hardware_target_stated: Free Google Colab T4 GPU (15GB VRAM) or L4/A100. Sequence length 1024 keeps a T4 comfortable.
